question.question: Scientific decision for Aloe ferox — leaf preparation containing hydroxyanthracene derivatives in an EU food supplement
question.indication: leaf preparation containing hydroxyanthracene derivatives in an EU food supplement

records.notes: EU rules prohibit preparations from Aloe species leaves containing hydroxyanthracene derivatives in foods because of genotoxic and carcinogenic safety concerns.
records.target_indication: leaf preparation containing hydroxyanthracene derivatives in an EU food supplement
